blank_meaning: No valid human judgment; do not impute
reviewer2_invalid_reason: export placeholders; not genuine human judgments
reviewer2_validity_rule: Valid iff sample_id is exactly one of R3-001 through R3-183. Apply this mask before any judgment QA or statistic, regardless of blank/nonblank values.
overlap_rule: Calculate from actual CSV keys after Reviewer 2 validity mask, then require both applicability values nonblank. Assert measured overlap equals 3290; never use 3290 as a substituted denominator.
core_metric: Unweighted three-class Cohen's kappa; exact agreement; NO/CLEAR severe and NO/PLAUSIBLE or PLAUSIBLE/CLEAR adjacent disagreements
